epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local setup time to under 5 minutes
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml or equivalent to start the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for verification

slices.title: Add docker-compose for full stack and health-check
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose setup, so that the product can be launched and verified for real.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a delivered project with no containerization
When I run the docker-compose command at the repository root
Then the full stack starts successfully and exposes a health-check endpoint
And E2E tests verify the health-check endpoint responds correctly
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% success rate for local startup via docker-compose

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time spent updating or deleting materials by 50%
requirements: R1: Add UI for updating materials
R2: Add UI for deleting materials

slices.title: Add UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing UI for this epic, I want to add edit and delete capabilities, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects current protocols.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the knowledge base
When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI
Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint
And E2E tests verify the full update and delete user journey
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% success rate on UI update and delete operations

epics.title: System Authentication and Authorization
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents to zero
epics.tocConstraintRef: System security and data protection bottleneck
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating a material
R2: Prompt unauthenticated users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication checks and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentication for this epic, I want to enforce access control, so that unauthorized access is blocked and users are prompted to log in.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user
When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material
Then they are blocked from access and prompted to log in
And E2E tests verify that unauthenticated access is reliably blocked
